_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround den un {width}x{height} grid.
Bo ta jugador {player_id}. Moveshon valido: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' o w/s/a/d.
Objetivo: sobrevivi mas ku tur otro. Rastro ta mortal; golpe di murá mata; choque di kabes mata tur dos.

game_action.invalid_death: E hungadó {player_id} a fayesé pa motibu di un move invalido.

outcome.survived_win: E hungadó {player_id} a sobrebibí; tur otro tabata den e aksidente.
outcome.all_crashed: Tur hungadó a kibra na mesun momento.
outcome.outlived: E hungadó a sobreviví na tur otro.
outcome.turn_limit: E límite di turno a yega - esun ku keda mas largu ta gana.
